Allah Ta'ala yahan irshad farmata hai apne bulandiyon wale parwarish karne wale Allah ke paak naam ki pakeezgi aur tasbeeh bayan karo jisne tamam makhlooq ko paida kiya aur sab ko achi hai'at bakshi. Goya ma'ani yeh bhi ban sakte hain lekin kuch zyada theek nazar nahin aate kyunke mufassireen ke aqwal ke khilaf hain. Imam Ibn Jarir toh isi matlab ko pasand karte hain aur matlab is aayat ka yeh hai ke jo Quran hum tujhe parhate hain use na bhool, haan jise hum khud mansookh kar dein uski aur baat hai. Allah par bandon ke chhupe khule a'maal, ahwal, aqaaid sab zahir hain. Hum tujh par bhalai ke kaam, achi baatein, shar'i amr aasaan kar denge, na is mein kaji hogi na sakhti, na jurm hoga. Toh naseehat kar agar naseehat faide de. Is se maloom hua ke nalaiqon ko na sikhana chahiye, jaise ke Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Ali R.A farmate hain ke agar tum dusron ke sath woh baatein karoge jo unki aql mein na aa sakein toh natija yeh hoga ke tumhari bhali baatein unke liye buri ban jayengi aur ba'is-e-fitna ho jayengi, balkay logon se unki samajh ke mutabiq baat-cheet karo taake log Allah aur Rasool ko na jhutlayein.

Phir farmaya ke is se nasihat woh hasil karega jis ke dil mein Allah ka khauf hai jo us ki mulaqat par yaqeen rakhta hai aur is se woh ibrat-o-nasihat hasil nahin kar sakta jo badbakht ho jo jahannam mein jaane wala ho jahan na toh rahat ki zindagi hai na bhali maut hai balkeh woh lazawal azab aur daimi burai hai is mein tarah tarah ke azab aur badtareen sazayein hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke jo asli jahannami hain unhein na toh maut aayegi na kar-amad zindagi milegi. Is ma'ani ki ayatein aur bhi hain.

Hazrat Abu Al-Aliyah (R.H) ne ek martaba Abu Khuldah se farmaya ke kal jab eid-gah jao to mujh se milte jana, jab main gaya to mujh se kaha kuch kha liya hai? Main ne kaha haan, farmaya naha chuke ho? Main ne kaha haan, farmaya zakat-e-fitr ada kar chuke ho? Main ne kaha haan, farmaya bas yahi kehna tha ke is ayat mein yahi murad hai. Ahl-e-Madina fitra se aur pani pilane se afzal aur koi sadqa nahin jante the. Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H) bhi logon ko fitra ada karne ka hukm karte phir isi ayat ki tilawat karte. Hazrat Abu Al-Ahwas (R.H) farmate hain jab tum mein se koi namaz ka irada kare aur koi sail aa jaye to use khairat de de, phir yahi ayat padhi. Hazrat Qatadah (R.H) farmate hain us ne apne maal ko pak kar liya aur apne Rab ko razi kar liya. Phir irshad hai ke tum duniya ki zindagi ko akhirat ki zindagi par tarjeeh de rahe ho aur darasal tumhari maslahat, tumhara nafa ukhrawi zindagi ko dunyawi zindagi par tarjeeh dene mein hai. Duniya zaleel hai, fani hai, akhirat shareef hai, baqi hai. Koi aqil aisa nahin kar sakta ke fani ko baqi ki jagah ikhtiyar kar le aur is fani ke intezam mein pad kar is baqi ke ehtimam ko chhod de. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain duniya us ka ghar hai jis ka akhirat mein na ho, duniya us ka maal hai jis ka maal wahan na ho, ise jama karne ke peeche woh lagte hain jo bewaqoof hain. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke Hazrat Arfajah Thaqafi is surat ko Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ud (R.A) ke paas padh rahe the, jab is ayat par pahunche to tilawat chhod kar apne sathiyon se farmane lage ke sach hai hum ne duniya ko akhirat par tarjeeh di. Log khamosh rahe to aap ne phir farmaya ke is liye ke hum duniya ke garwidah ho gaye ke yahan ki zeenat ko, yahan ki aurton ko, yahan ke khane peene ko hum ne dekh liya, akhirat nazron se ojhal hai is liye hum ne is samne wali ki taraf tawajjah ki aur is nazar na aane wali se aankhein pher lin. Ya to yeh farman Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ka bator-e-tawazo ke hai ya jins-e-insan ki babat farmate hain, Wallahu A'lam.

Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jis ne duniya se mohabbat ki us ne apni aakhirat ko nuqsan pohanchaya aur jis ne aakhirat se mohabbat rakhi us ne duniya ko nuqsan pohanchaya tum ae logo! Baqi rehne wali ko fana hone wali par tarjeeh do, Musnad-e-Ahmad. Phir farmata hai ke Ibrahim aur Musa (A.S) ke saheefon mein bhi yeh tha. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke yeh sab bayan un saheefon mein bhi tha (Bazzar). Nasai mein Hazrat Abbas (R.A) se yeh marwi hai aur jab aayat (وَاِبْرٰهِيْمَ الَّذِيْ وَفّيٰٓ 37؀ۙ) (53-An-Najm: 37) nazil hui to farmaya ke is se murad yeh hai ke ek ka bojh dusre ko na uthana hai. Surah Najm mein hai aayat (اَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّاْ بِمَا فِيْ صُحُفِ مُوْسٰى 36؀ۙ) (53-An-Najm: 36) aakhri mazmoon tak ki tamam aayatein yani yeh sab ahkaam agli kitabon mein bhi thay. Isi tarah yahan bhi murad Sabbih Isma ki yeh aayatein hain. Baaz ne poori surah kahi hai, baaz ne Qad Aflaha se Abqa tak kaha hai, zyada qawi bhi yahi qaul maloom hota hai, Wallahu A'lam. Alhamdulillah Surah Sabbih ki tafseer khatam hui, Wallahul Hamdu wal Minnah wa bihit Tawfeeq wal 'Ismah.
